dedupe_keys.name: permafrost thaw settlement r processing and comparison code

description: The University of Calgary thaw-settlement research team provides an R workflow for processing permafrost test measurements and comparing empirical settlement calculations. Three ordered scripts define utility functions, process raw measurements and method constants, and generate figures and tables. Inputs include sample measurements, borehole-source metadata, particle-size distributions and validation subsets; outputs include processed datasets and comparison figures. GitHub supplies the source under MIT, and Zenodo archives the essd-pts-final release. The README reports R 4.4.2 on Windows 11 and lists required packages. The method is not tied to one country, although its supplied samples have their own geographic coverage. It can prepare and inspect geotechnical parameters used in infrastructure settlement simulations and complements the separate thaw-settlement dataset. The README clone example contains a placeholder, and its named Instructions.Rmd file was absent from the inspected root listing. Those limitations require attention before reproduction. No R code was executed or numerical result independently checked.
